objs.name: document
objs.description: Core artifact representing a policy, guideline, instruction or other document managed in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References to other documents or information; maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Master data attribute linking to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational units relevant to the document.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational areas where the document is valid.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Readers who have view permissions for the document and dependent objects.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Primary author(s) of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional authors with editing rights; not necessarily signing in release workflow.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Individuals responsible for technical and formal checks during review.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Individuals responsible for releasing the document.

attributes.name: creator
attributes.description: Initial creator of the document; can be changed.

attributes.name: distribution_list
attributes.description: List of groups or users for distribution and acknowledgement.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of document (e.g., policy, guideline, work instruction).

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Document template(s) used for this document type.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version identifier; part of versioning and revision.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status in the workflow (e.g., editing, released).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope(s) associated with the document; used by TAG technology.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A document attachment that is linked to a parent document; treated as a separate controlled object.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Parent document to which this attachment belongs.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information added to a document.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Parent document.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Additional equipment attached to a document; subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Parent document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changes to a document; managed within the document cockpit.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Underlying document this change proposal refers to.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal.

attributes.name: proposer
attributes.description: Author who created the change proposal.

attributes.name: change_content
attributes.description: Text describing the proposed changes.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: New documents are created in the system by attaching a new information object, with selection of the corresponding document type.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Subsequent changes to the content or properties are possible; versioning and revision apply.

evts.name: attach_object_to_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new information object to a document (e.g., attachments, additional info, equippment, or change proposals).

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: All documents can have a Change Proposal created; Change proposals are managed in the Cockpit.

evts.name: manage_change_proposals
evts.description: Change proposals can be created and managed; includes the Change proposals folder.

evts.name: submit_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit change proposals for consideration in the workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and formal aspects; multiple reviewers may be involved.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The 3-step release process (Creator - Review - Release) is started to publish a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released documents into another language; translation can be viewed and edited per language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version must be checked and released with workflow support; only released translations are visible to readers.

evts.name: assign_reviewers
evts.description: Assign reviewers to a document for technical and formal checks.

evts.name: assign_releasers
evts.description: Assign releasers to a document for releasing content.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Check and extend document validity before expiry; includes notifying authors, co-authors and reviewers.

evts.name: override
evts.description: Override (AKS) for a document; the process decides invalidation and archiving.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: To invalidate documents; creates AKS and starts an override process.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Reactivation process to re-validate invalidated documents.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Distribution of documents to user groups and individuals; can trigger email distribution.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform distribution groups and individuals by email when a new version is released.

evts.name: acknowledge_document
evts.description: Acknowledgement workflow where recipients confirm receipt and acknowledgement.

evts.name: translate_approval
evts.description: Approval process for translated documents (translation requires release).

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation for a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: override_release_check
evts.description: The AKS check performed by releaser as part of Override workflow.

evts.name: publish_signatures
evts.description: Electronic signatures are collected and documented for released versions.

evts.name: print_signatures
evts.description: Signatures can be printed with the document content.

o2o.description: Attachment is linked to a Document.
Additional information associated with a Document.
Change proposals associated with a Document.

o2e.description: Event affects Document and the attached object.
